items.title: FKA twigs Drops Lawsuit Against Shia LaBeouf After Actor Voids NDA
items.summary: The singer initially claimed he was trying to stop her from “disclosing information about her own survival of sexual assault”

items.title: Freddie Jackson Dead At 69
items.summary: Freddie Jackson, the R&B singer who made a long string of smooth romantic hits from the mid-'80s to the early '90s, has passed away.

items.title: Music Industry Moves: Thomas Rhett Strikes Label Partnership With Hybe’s Blue Highway Records
items.summary: Country star Thomas Rhett and Hybe Americas’ Nashville-based label Blue Highway Records have announced a new partnership, Fifty-One/Forty-Nine Records.

items.title: Jessica Biel Joins Searchlight Pictures’ ‘Playmates’
items.summary: Jessica Biel has found her next feature project in Playmates, the Searchlight flick inspired by filmmaker Lorraine Nicholson’s experiences growing up at the Playboy Mansion.

items.title: Warner Bros. Water Tower Already Repainted to Add ‘A Skydance Corporation’ After Merger Closes
items.summary: David Ellison wasted no time in adding the Skydance name to the iconic Warner Bros. water tower in Burbank. On Tuesday morning, shortly after Paramount officially closed its $111 billion merger with Warner Bros.
